extra_citations.quote: In case of neglect or refusal to pay the rent due from a tenant at will, fourteen days' notice to quit, given in writing by the landlord to the tenant, shall be sufficient to determine the tenancy; provided, that the tenancy of a tenant who has not received a similar notice from the landlord within the twelve months next preceding the receipt of such notice shall not be determined if the tenant, within ten days after the receipt thereof, pays or tenders to the landlord, the landlord's attorney, or the person to whom the tenant customarily pays rent, the full amount of any rent due.

Such presumption shall be rebutted only by clear and convincing evidence that such person's action was not a reprisal against the tenant and that such person had sufficient independent justification for taking such action, and would have in fact taken such action, in the same manner and at the same time the action was taken, regardless of tenants engaging in, or the belief that tenants had engaged in, activities protected under this section.

Upon the neglect or refusal to pay the rent due under a written lease, fourteen days' notice to quit, given in writing by the landlord to the tenant, shall be sufficient to determine the lease, unless the tenant, on or before the day the answer is due, in an action by the landlord to recover possession of the premises, pays or tenders to the landlord or to his attorney all rent then due, with interest and costs of suit.

summary.en: Housing providers must look at each applicant's case one by one. They cannot refuse someone just because they have an old criminal record. They cannot consider arrests, records wiped off by a judge, or convictions over 5 years old.
summary.es: Los proveedores de vivienda deben revisar el caso de cada solicitante por separado. No pueden rechazar a alguien solo porque tiene un registro criminal antiguo. No pueden considerar arrestos, antecedentes eliminados por un juez, o condenas de más de 5 años.

summary.en: Massachusetts would ban the use of rent-setting software to set rental prices. Landlords could not use algorithms to determine how much rent to charge.
summary.es: Massachusetts prohibiría el uso de software para fijar rentas al establecer precios de alquiler. Los arrendadores no podrían usar algoritmos para determinar cuánta renta cobrar.

who.en: This rule applies to all residential rentals in Massachusetts.
